'''Gold 1''' was the designation of a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was flown by [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] and had previously been designated as '''Specter 1''' when the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] had been part of [[Specter Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Specter Squadron]] and stationed at [[Renforra Base]].<ref name="CCG-Gold1" /> Gold 1 was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] when Vander attempted to launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="ANH" />
